Non-Functional Requirements:
User Interface: The system should have a user-friendly interface that is easy to navigate and use.
Compatibility: The system should be compatible with Android operating systems.

Data Security: The system should have robust security features to protect sensitive data, including encryption and secure data storage.
Conclusion:
This software requirement document outlines the features and requirements for an Android-based inventory system that can be integrated with Reverb.com and eBay.com. I'm helping a bioinformatics company develop ML/DL/Deep Generative Models in a young and tightly-knit team; I'm looking to add one or two more part-timers. If you're an expert willing to act paid consultant one hour a week, or a graduate with the ability to tackle most areas in the role, let us know. 

We are developing predictive models for estimating e.g. biomolecules using, e.g. hyperspectral imagery, bio-marker measurements, and text descriptions). Our models are smaller pieces needed for a bigger algorithm. Datasets are high dimensions; often incomplete/have missing values (inputs and outputs); some data is unstructured; models are inverse and ill-posed. So experience and knowledge in variable selection (probably where we have more limited expertise from an ML point of view), handling missing data, and managing unstructured data are necessary. Ideal candidates would likely have experience in advanced imputation techniques (before and during training). Note: it's required to include uncertainties/confidence intervals of your model predictions using principled means. The completed datasets we produce are getting fed into an overarching algorithm concurrently being developed. This is where there is an opportunity for becoming permanent. If that's your aim, work with us to demonstrate involvement and understanding of the broader project aims and challenges, by factoring that into your work. There are complex data pipelines, requiring understanding how it all fits together/ what's been laid down and developing them further with your contributions. Put our work needs to be undertaken considering the bigger picture and not just the individual model we create on a given week. Your work should also be documented concisely yet comprehensively for downstream use and diagnostics. Finally, please also consider your ability to meet the job role in the context of the broad, multidisciplinary field of bioinformatics. Science at even A-Level or equivalent would be helpful, such as for discussions with experts who can theoretically guide your data/model formulations. 

All that said a great thing about this work is the flexibility and modularity of what's happening. We learn from each other, which is what I get out of it most anyway. So feel free to apply even if you cannot contribute much time each week, or if not to all of the work areas mentioned. The key is to state what areas you are 100% sure of being able to accomplish individually and being consistent in hours/week so I can distribute the workload. 1-20 hours, whatever.
